chapters.title: Executive Overview — The Vanta + Drata + VRINDA All-in-One Super App & Database-per-Tenant Architecture
chapters.badge: CONTROL PLANE + TENANT DB ISOLATION | 18/18 GAPS DONE | M1-M10 100%
chapters.codeSnippet: TenantDbContext -> postgres://tenant_{id} | ProviderClaim uniqueness | Zero cross-tenant leakage
chapters.narration: Welcome to D2D Audit Services, the all-in-one compliance and cloud security super app unifying Vanta, Drata, and VRINDA in a single platform. Every customer workspace runs inside a dedicated PostgreSQL database per tenant, orchestrated by a central Control Plane with strict Provider Claim uniqueness and role-scoped authorization across all ten milestones.
bullets: 100% physical database-per-tenant isolation with automated EF Core migration parity gates
Unifies continuous GRC compliance, cloud posture, blast-radius attack paths, and buyer trust
18 of 18 Gap Tracker capabilities and Milestones M1 through M10 delivered end-to-end

chapters.title: Multi-Cloud CSPM (AWS, Azure, GCP) & 13 Compliance Frameworks + What-If Gap Simulator

chapters.narration: Chapter Two covers Multi-Cloud C S P M and our thirteen embedded compliance frameworks. Live collectors inspect AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud across sixteen automated checks. Security teams track readiness across SOC 2, ISO 27001, 27017, 27018, 42001, HIPAA, GDPR, PCI DSS 4.0, NIST CSF 2.0, DORA, NIST AI RMF, the EU AI Act, and IEC 62443, and run the What-If Gap Simulator to adopt missing controls in one click.
bullets: Live AWS, Azure Entra/Storage/KeyVault/NSG, and GCP IAM/Buckets/KMS/Audit collector pipeline
13 built-in regulatory and AI frameworks plus custom CSV framework upload and control import
Interactive What-If Gap Simulator shows immediate readiness lift and adopts gap controls in 1 click

chapters.title: Cloud Security Intelligence — Public Exposure, 1-Click Terraform/CLI Remediation & Blast-Radius Attack Paths
chapters.badge: INTERNET EXPOSURE -> LEAKED SECRET -> IDENTITY GAP -> PII STORE
chapters.narration: Chapter Three introduces VRINDA-grade Cloud Security Intelligence and Blast-Radius Attack Paths. The Exposure engine detects internet-open security groups, public buckets, and exposed databases, generating copy-ready Terraform H C L, AWS CLI, Azure CLI, and GCloud remediation patches. Our Attack Path Analyzer correlates public exposures, leaked secrets, identity gaps, and PII stores into multi-hop blast-radius graphs with a single chokepoint fix.
bullets: Continuous public exposure scanning with deterministic Terraform HCL and cloud CLI remediation patches
Multi-hop blast-radius correlation: Internet Exposure -> Secret/CVE -> Identity Gap -> PII Data Store
1-click GitHub Pull Request remediation generator in Governance Hub to close exposure chokepoints

chapters.title: Container CVEs, OSS Licenses, Baked-in Secrets (SARIF 2.1.0), DSPM PII Discovery & FinOps × Compliance
chapters.badge: SARIF 2.1.0 SECRET REDACTION | DSPM PII/PHI/PCI | FINOPS x CONTROL CORRELATION
chapters.codeSnippet: SarifParser.RedactSnippet() -> [REDACTED-SECRET] | FinOps savings linked to CFG-01, CR-02, BC-01
chapters.narration: Chapter Four unites application vulnerability scanning, Data Security Posture Management, and FinOps. Engineers import SARIF 2.1.0 reports to track container C V Es, copyleft open-source licenses, and baked-in secrets with automatic token redaction. D S P M classifies PII, PHI, and PCI data stores by encryption and residency risk, while FinOps correlates cloud cost savings directly with failing controls.
bullets: Automatic secret redaction on SARIF 2.1.0 ingestion prevents credential leakage inside scan findings
DSPM evaluates encryption at rest, public access, data residency, and retention across cloud stores
FinOps x Compliance links every cost optimization directly to the compliance controls it resolves

chapters.title: Tamper-Evident Evidence Chain (Parquet + SHA-256 + S3 Object Lock) & Audit Time Machine
chapters.shortTitle: SHA-256 Evidence Chain & Audit Time Machine
chapters.badge: PARQUET SNAPSHOTS | SHA-256 HASH CHAIN | S3 OBJECT LOCK | AUDIT TIME MACHINE
chapters.codeSnippet: Head = SHA256(PreviousHead\nContentHash\nCanonical) | S3 COMPLIANCE Object Lock | Web Crypto Verify
chapters.narration: Chapter Five showcases our tamper-evident Evidence Chain and the Audit Time Machine. Every collector snapshot and uploaded artifact is serialized to Parquet or raw bytes, hashed with SHA-256, and chained to the previous entry hash in S3 Object Lock compatible storage. Users can verify byte integrity locally in their browser via Web Crypto and diff historical posture snapshots across any two dates in the Audit Time Machine.
bullets: Per-tenant serialized EvidenceWriter prevents sequence collisions and links every SHA-256 entry hash
Browser-native Web Crypto SHA-256 verification proves downloaded bytes match the recorded chain hash
Audit Time Machine compares historical posture snapshots to show exact control and evidence deltas

chapters.title: Trust Center v2 — Clickwrap NDA (X-Trust-Token), Buyer-Verifiable Cryptographic Receipts & Trust AI Q&A
chapters.badge: X-TRUST-TOKEN NDA HEADER | FULL-CHAIN CRYPTOGRAPHIC RECEIPT | PUBLIC TRUST AI Q&A
chapters.codeSnippet: GET /api/v1/public/trust/{slug}/receipt -> Verify canonical payload SHA-256 in Buyer Browser
chapters.narration: Chapter Six demonstrates Trust Center version two. Prospective buyers inspect live framework readiness, submit clickwrap N D A requests, and download gated reports using constant-time validated X-Trust-Token headers without leaking tokens in URLs. Buyers can independently verify the Cryptographic Trust Receipt anchored to the workspace evidence chain head hash, or ask the grounded Trust Center A I assistant.
bullets: Cryptographic Trust Receipts verify full-chain continuity from genesis to head hash before signing
Constant-time X-Trust-Token header validation protects NDA-gated documents from URL/referer leakage
Public Trust Center AI Q&A answers buyer security questions strictly from published posture data

chapters.title: Workforce, Checkr, KnowBe4, MDM/Endpoint Agent, RoPA/DPIA, AI Model Registry & Multi-Entity Rollup

chapters.narration: Chapter Seven tours workforce security and the Enterprise Governance Hub. D2D integrates Jamf, Intune, Kandji, and endpoint device agent check-ins alongside Checkr background checks, KnowBe4 phishing simulations, and SCIM 2.0 directory sync. The Governance Hub adds parent-child Multi-Entity Rollups, GDPR Record of Processing Activities and D P I A assessments, and an A I Model Governance Registry mapped to ISO 42001 and the EU AI Act.
bullets: Live & deterministic adapters for Checkr background checks, KnowBe4 phishing campaigns, and SCIM 2.0
GDPR RoPA & DPIA registers plus AI Model Registry tracking bias/hallucination tests and human oversight
Multi-Entity Rollup aggregates readiness, controls, and open risks across global business units

chapters.title: Auditor Workspace, Grounded AI Assistant, Developer API Keys (Bearer d2d_api_...), Signed Webhooks & Open-Source Jenkins CI
chapters.shortTitle: Auditor Portal, API Keys, Webhooks & Jenkins CI
chapters.badge: BEARER d2d_api_... | HMAC-SHA256 WEBHOOKS | AUDITOR ISOLATION | JENKINS + RENDER DEPLOY
chapters.narration: Finally, Chapter Eight covers the External Auditor Workspace, Grounded A I Assistant, Developer Console, and CI/CD infrastructure. External auditors operate under strict framework and storage-prefix isolation. Developers automate workflows with tenant-bound Bearer API keys and SSRF-hardened HMAC-SHA256 outbound webhooks. The entire stack builds via self-hosted open-source Jenkins CI and deploys cleanly via Terraform or Render Blueprint.
